name: Area Authority
definition: Accountable for everything that happens at a location: plant status, permits, simultaneous operations and release of work.
held_by: OPS-08; OPS-04; OPS-02; OPS-05; SCM-03; CCS-03

name: Technical Authority
definition: Discipline lead who owns the technical standards of a discipline and endorses designs, changes and deviations, independent of line management.
held_by: EXD-04; EXD-05; EXD-06; EXD-07; EXD-08; WEL-04; WEL-05; WEL-06; ENP-04; ENP-05; ENP-06; ENP-07; ENP-08; ENP-09; ENP-10; ENP-11; ENP-12; ENP-13; ENP-14; ENP-15; OPS-06; OPS-09; OPS-10; OPS-11; HSE-05; HSE-06; HSE-08; HSE-09; SCM-05; SCM-06; IDK-04; IDK-05

name: Performing Authority
definition: Leads a work party: accepts the permit, briefs the crew, monitors the work and hands the worksite back.
held_by: OPS-13; OPS-14; OPS-12; OPS-07; SCM-07; WEL-07

name: Isolating Authority
definition: Authorised to prepare, apply and verify energy isolations and to reinstate plant.

name: Permit to Work Coordinator
definition: Runs the permit office at a site: checks permits, keeps the isolation register and plans simultaneous operations.

name: Well Control Authority
definition: ACE's representative at the wellsite, with authority over well control on the rig.

name: Element Owner
definition: Executive who owns one of the ten OMS elements: its expectations, its performance and its improvement.

name: Document Owner
definition: Accountable for a controlled document: its content, its review on time and its revision.

name: Document Controller
definition: Registers, checks, publishes and revises controlled documents.

name: Risk Owner
definition: Accountable for a risk in the register: its assessment, its controls and its actions.

name: Control Owner
definition: Accountable for one control: that it is in place, tested and working.

name: Process Owner
definition: Accountable for a business process: its design, its performance and its improvement.

name: MOC Coordinator
definition: Screens and tracks changes through the Management of Change process.

name: Emergency Response Coordinator
definition: Keeps emergency plans, drills and the response organisation ready.

name: Auditor
definition: Independent check that the OMS works as written.

name: OMS Manager
definition: Custodian of the OMS framework and its mapping to the ten elements; runs conformance assessments.
